race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: MARIANNE MOZART is putting it all together now, having shown improved form in a first-time hood before building on that promise to get off the mark at Kempton 9 days ago. She runs off an unchanged mark and can follow up. Lord Abama is only 2 lb higher than for a recent course success and that leaves him still very well treated on old form so he's respected and Pit Boss is capable if getting some luck and the race is run to suit his hold-up style. MARIANNE MOZART (IRE) LORD ABAMA (IRE) PIT BOSS
